card.name: Small linking words before a noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as a, using, of, by and and, right before a method, agent or named person. They appear in descriptive prose about a technique, a discovery or a cause.

modes.label: Article before a method or agent
modes.description: The word a comes just before a described method or biological source.
modes.example: soil resistivity testing using<< a>> 4-point method

modes.label: Of or by before a person or group
modes.description: Of or by links a work or discovery to the person or group credited.
modes.example: the discovery of cinecoronary angiography<< by>> F. MASON SONES in

modes.label: Joining list items
modes.description: And or using inside a list of technical topics.
modes.example: the fall of potential method<< and>> use of the clamp-on test meter.

card.writes: It slightly favors words like linear and curve and disfavors feedback and snake, but the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words like a, by or of just before a method, source or person is named.
